subject: Update server function's name to valkey (#456)
reason: The change only renames internal C functions (genRedisInfoString and its CommandStats/ACLStats/LatencyStats helpers to genValkeyInfo*) and updates every call site in debug.c, module.c, sentinel.c, server.c and the declarations in server.h, plus two comments. No function body, format string, reply content, or control flow changes; any missed call site would fail compilation. There is no externally observable behavior to test, so no scenario is needed.
